description: Follows Victor Frankenstein and his creature through competing narratives of creation, abandonment, responsibility, and revenge. Covers Walton, Victor, and the Night of Creation; Justine, the De Laceys, and the Creature’s Account; The Promise and the Destroyed Companion; A Close-Reading Workshop on Ambition and Testimony.
